faunamanager.config.title: Fauna Compat Manager
faunamanager.config.tooltip: 'All' (default): both mobs coexist unchanged, no FaunaManager intervention. Or pick the specific mod you want for %s.
faunamanager.config.maintenance.cleanup_: To remove suppressed mobs already present in the world, use the command /faunamanager cleanup (preview, removes nothing) and /faunamanager cleanup confirm (actually removes them). Tamed animals and named entities are NEVER removed. Requires operator permission. Only affects currently loaded chunks.
faunamanager.cleanup.preview: Preview: %s suppressed mobs would be removed (%s tamed/named entities skipped).
faunamanager.cleanup.done: Done: %s suppressed mobs removed (%s tamed/named entities skipped).
